title: Kind, Honest & Modest: Personality Traits & Moral Character
primaryPurpose: Introduce personality, temperament, and moral character vocabulary (тусархаг, шударга, даруу, нийтэч, хөдөлмөрч, тайван, зан ааш, төлөв даруу).
communicativeOutcome: Describe a person's inner virtues, work ethic, social disposition, and temperament in personal or professional appraisals.
readingObjective: Read letters of recommendation describing an applicant's integrity, diligence, and collegiality.
listeningObjective: Understand an employer praising an employee's honesty and teamwork.
writingObjective: List 6 moral character adjectives with short English definitions.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe a friend's character: 'Манай найз маш тусархаг, шударга, бас их даруухан зантай'.
pragmaticTarget: Using cultural virtue concepts (даруухан, тусархаг) to praise peers respectfully.
reviewReason: Expands simple adjectives (сайн, муу) to rich characterization traits.
audioPurpose: Pronounce moral and personality adjectives clearly.
successCriteria: Defines тусархаг (helpful), шударга (honest/fair), нийтэч (sociable), хөдөлмөрч (hardworking)
Forms predicative character descriptions: 'Тэр хүн их төлөв даруу'
masteryEvidence: Accurately characterizes 4 coworkers across diligence, honesty, and social disposition.

title: Deciphering Recommendation Letters & Character References
primaryPurpose: Develop reading comprehension of formal character appraisals (тодорхойлолт), academic reference letters, and workplace peer evaluations.
communicativeOutcome: Inspect a professional recommendation letter, identify praised virtues (хариуцлагатай, нямбай, хамт олонч), and evaluate candidate suitability.
readingObjective: Extract candidate strengths (нягт нямбай, итгэл найдвартай) and supervisor endorsements from a 120-word reference letter.
writingObjective: Transcribe 3 core virtues from a reference text into a summary evaluation card.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain to a hiring manager why the recommended candidate is dependable.
registerTarget: Formal workplace appraisal and recommendation register
pragmaticTarget: Understanding formal praise idioms in Mongolian corporate culture.
reviewReason: Deepens occupational reading from duties to personal ethics and character.
audioPurpose: Read formal recommendation text aloud.
successCriteria: Identifies key professional attributes: хариуцлагатай (responsible), нямбай (meticulous)
Determines supervisor's overall endorsement sentiment
masteryEvidence: Answers 4 comprehension questions on an authentic Mongolian character reference letter.

title: Acoustic Lab: Conversational Impressions & Friendship Confidences
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of two close friends sharing personal impressions of a new roommate, colleague, or prospective in-law.
communicativeOutcome: Extract nuanced character assessments (whether someone is cheerful, short-tempered, trustworthy, or reserved) from candid audio conversations.
listeningObjective: Identify specific temperament traits ('Тэр залуу их хөгжилтэй, гэхдээ хааяа түргэн зантай') from candid dialogue audio.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain to a peer why the speaker trusts their new colleague.
pragmaticTarget: Deciphering colloquial character descriptors with balanced objectivity.
reviewReason: Applies third-person enclitic 'нь' listening to character appraisals ('зан нь сайхан').
audioPurpose: Natural conversational cadence between two friends discussing mutual acquaintances.
successCriteria: Identifies both positive strengths and mild character flaws from audio stream
Extracts speaker's overall verdict on candidate's trustworthiness
masteryEvidence: Accurately profiles 3 individuals based on overheard conversational evaluations.

title: Peer Review: Discussing Coworker Strengths & Team Dynamics
primaryPurpose: Master spoken communication for evaluating coworkers, discussing team collaboration, and describing interpersonal dynamics in a workplace setting.
communicativeOutcome: Participate in a workplace peer review or team debrief, articulating colleagues' strengths and interpersonal qualities constructively.
listeningObjective: Understand team leader asking for honest feedback on project collaboration.
spokenProductionObjective: Provide balanced feedback: 'Болд бол маш хариуцлагатай, нямбай ажилтан. Хамт олонтойгоо нийтэч, тусархаг харьцдаг'.
pragmaticTarget: Offering constructive, balanced praise that reinforces team harmony.
reviewReason: Transitions workplace talk from task descriptions to professional team appraisal.
audioPurpose: Polished, diplomatic workplace dialogue between two respectful colleagues.
successCriteria: Articulates coworker strengths using at least 3 distinct character adjectives
Maintains respectful, encouraging tone throughout professional exchange
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn peer evaluation dialogue highlighting colleague contributions seamlessly.

title: Stories of the Past: The Narrative Past Tense (-в)
primaryPurpose: Introduce the literary and formal narrative past tense suffix (-в / -эв / -ов / -өв) used in storytelling, biographical chronicles, historical narratives, and written recollections.
communicativeOutcome: Narrate chronological life events in formal or literary style: 'Би хөдөө өсөв' (I grew up in the countryside), 'Тэр сургуулиа төгсөв' (He graduated).
readingObjective: Read an excerpt from a famous Mongolian author's childhood biography written with narrative past -в.
listeningObjective: Identify narrative past verbs ending in -в in audio storytelling.
writingObjective: Transform 4 conversational past sentences into formal narrative style using -в.
spokenProductionObjective: Recite a short biographical sequence: 'Миний өвөө 1945 онд цэрэгт татагдав. Дараа нь сумандаа багшлав'.
registerTarget: Formal narrative and written biographical register
pragmaticTarget: Using the narrative past (-в) for structured, authoritative biographical recounting.
reviewReason: Contrasts spoken witnessed past (-лаа4) with formal written narrative past (-в).
audioPurpose: Model crisp syllable-final /w/ or /v/ articulation in narrative verbs.
successCriteria: Attaches -в or epenthetic vowel + -в according to consonant/vowel phonotactics
Contrasts narrative past -в with colloquial past -лаа appropriately
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би багадаа голын хөвөөнд тоглож өсөв' accurately in a written narrative.

title: Riverbanks & Summer Pastures: Childhood Memories & Nostalgia
primaryPurpose: Introduce childhood pastimes, rural nostalgia, and hometown vocabulary (төрсөн нутаг, бага нас, дурсамж, зуслан, голын хөвөө, шагайн наадам, хурга хариулах).
communicativeOutcome: Recount nostalgic childhood memories, summer vacations at grandparents' pastures, herding lambs, and playing traditional games.
readingObjective: Read a poetic essay on memories of nomadic childhood summers in Arkhangai.
listeningObjective: Understand an interviewee reminiscing about learning to ride horses at age six.
writingObjective: List 5 traditional childhood activities in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Share a childhood memory: 'Би багадаа зун бүр өвөөгийнхөө хөдөө очиж хурга хариулдаг байсан'.
pragmaticTarget: Evoking authentic Mongolian pastoral memories with heartfelt cultural resonance.
reviewReason: Spirals countryside landscape terms into personal autobiographical memories.
audioPurpose: Pronounce nostalgic childhood vocabulary clearly.
successCriteria: Defines бага нас (childhood), дурсамж (memory), төрсөн нутаг (birthplace/hometown)
Narrates childhood episodes using narrative past verbs
masteryEvidence: Accurately describes 4 childhood memories using rich rural and play terminology.

title: School Reunion: Reminiscing About Childhood & Old Classmates
primaryPurpose: Develop spoken communicative fluency for reminiscing with old classmates: discussing childhood mischief, favorite teachers, schoolyard games, and hometown changes.
communicativeOutcome: Engage in an extended nostalgic conversation with an old friend or classmate, exchanging memories of childhood events and school experiences.
listeningObjective: Understand classmate recalling a humorous childhood soccer mishap.
spokenProductionObjective: Reminisce: 'Чи 10 жилийн өмнөх тэр зуныг санаж байна уу? Бид хоёр өдөржин гол дээр сэлдэг байсан сан'.
pragmaticTarget: Using empathetic conversational tags ('санаж байна уу?', 'тийм шүү') in shared reminiscence.
reviewReason: Deepens past narrative dialogue from recent weekends to lifelong childhood memories.
audioPurpose: Lively laughter, fond nostalgic pauses, and warm colloquial backchanneling between friends.
successCriteria: Prompts and responds to shared memories using past forms accurately
Expresses nostalgic sentiment using appropriate conversational markers
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn reunion dialogue reminiscing about elementary school days with ease.

title: Acoustic Lab: Radio Memoirs & Hometown Audio Essays
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of professional radio essayists narrating lyrical childhood memoirs set in historic aimags and countryside valleys.
communicativeOutcome: Extract chronological life milestones, regional details, and emotional reflections from a literary radio broadcast.
listeningObjective: Identify specific narrative past forms (-в) and geographic landmarks in a 90-second radio memoir.
spokenProductionObjective: Summarize the radio narrator's childhood memory of winter horses in 3 Mongolian sentences.
registerTarget: High literary and broadcast cultural memoir register
pragmaticTarget: Parsing expressive intonation, poetic pauses, and rich descriptive adjectives in spoken literary Mongolian.
reviewReason: Elevates listening stamina to poetic and broadcast narrative prose.
audioPurpose: Deep, lyrical narrator voice with evocative traditional morin khuur background chords.
successCriteria: Identifies narrator's childhood valley and historical timeframe from audio
Extracts at least 3 narrative past verbs ending in -в from the recording
masteryEvidence: Accurately maps out narrator's childhood memories onto a chronological milestone timeline.

title: My Native Land: Writing a Lyrical Hometown Recollection Essay
primaryPurpose: Synthesize narrative past tense (-в), nostalgic childhood vocabulary, and sequential converbs into a written autobiographical essay (Миний төрсөн нутаг ба бага нас).
communicativeOutcome: Draft a 6-sentence personal memoir describing your birthplace, early childhood memories, and how your hometown has evolved.
readingObjective: Review a classic student model memoir to observe opening rhetorical hooks.
writingObjective: Draft a 6-sentence nostalgic essay utilizing at least 3 narrative past verbs (-в) and 2 sequential converbs.
pragmaticTarget: Expressing deep affection for one's roots using traditional Mongolian literary stylistic conventions.
reviewReason: Combines sequential converbs (-аад) with narrative past verbs (-в) for structured storytelling.
audioPurpose: Audio read-back of written autobiographical essay.
successCriteria: Produces written essay with at least 3 correctly formed narrative past verbs in -в
Includes sensory descriptions of nature, family, or childhood games
masteryEvidence: Drafts 'Би Хөвсгөлийн үзэсгэлэнт байгальд төрж өсөв. Багадаа морь унаж, нуурын хөвөөгөөр гүйж өнгөрүүлэв...' flawlessly.

title: We Arrived at Khuvsgul: Recent Travel Narratives with -лаа4
primaryPurpose: Deepen and consolidate the witnessed past tense (-лаа4 / -лээ / -лоо / -лөө) for vivid, immediate personal travel narratives, personal sightings, and recent discoveries.
communicativeOutcome: Recount a recent vacation or countryside journey with conversational immediacy: 'Бид өчигдөр орой Хөвсгөл нуурын эрэгт майхнаа барилаа' (We pitched our tent on Khuvsgul shore last night).
readingObjective: Read a contemporary travel blog post recounting a 3-day road trip to Terelj National Park.
listeningObjective: Identify verbs in -лаа4 used to describe recent discoveries and arrivals in travel podcasts.
writingObjective: Write 4 sentences describing yesterday's road trip milestones using -лаа4.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain recent trip: 'Бид өглөө эрт гараад, өдөр нь Хархоринд хүрлээ'.
pragmaticTarget: Conveying excitement and fresh, first-hand witness experiences in travel stories.
reviewReason: Expands immediate daily past tense into extended multi-day travel itineraries.
audioPurpose: Model energetic conversational intonation on witnessed past predicates.
successCriteria: Selects correct harmonic variant of -лаа4 based on preceding vowel
Uses -лаа4 to convey personally experienced, fresh travel events
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Бид нуурын хөвөөнд хоноод, өглөө нь нар мандахыг харлаа' effortlessly.

title: Tents, Campfires & Trails: Wilderness Expedition Vocabulary
primaryPurpose: Introduce countryside camping, expedition, and nature travel vocabulary (аялал, майхан барих, түүдэг гал, үүргэвч, дурандах, жимээр алхах, нар мандах, жаргах).
communicativeOutcome: Describe wilderness camping, pitching a tent, gathering firewood, making a campfire, watching the sunrise, and trekking forest trails.
readingObjective: Read a wilderness camping guide outlining Leave-No-Trace principles in Mongolian national parks.
listeningObjective: Understand outdoor guide briefing hikers on campsite selection and firewood gathering.
writingObjective: List 5 essential camping equipment items in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe camping activities: 'Бид голын дэргэд майхнаа бариад, орой нь түүдэг гал асаалаа'.
pragmaticTarget: Understanding campfire safety and ecological respect when camping in the Mongolian steppe.
reviewReason: Connects pastoral landscapes with active outdoor adventure tourism.
audioPurpose: Pronounce wilderness and camping expedition terms clearly.
successCriteria: Defines майхан барих (pitch a tent), түүдэг гал (campfire), үүргэвч (backpack)
Forms complete sentences describing wilderness travel actions
masteryEvidence: Accurately describes 4 stages of setting up an outdoor camp in Mongolian.

title: On the Road: Composing a Countryside Travel Blog & Photo Log
primaryPurpose: Synthesize witnessed past tense (-лаа4), wilderness travel vocabulary, and descriptive adjectives into a vibrant written travel blog post.
communicativeOutcome: Write a 6-sentence travel blog post recounting a journey across the countryside, detailing route, campsite, wildlife, and memories.
readingObjective: Read a popular Mongolian travel blog entry for structure and photo captioning style.
writingObjective: Draft a 6-sentence travel blog entry with vivid descriptions utilizing at least 3 verbs in -лаа4.
registerTarget: Informal engaging digital travel writing register
pragmaticTarget: Engaging readers with captivating travel anecdotes and sensory scenery details.
reviewReason: Links sequential converbs (-аад) with witnessed past verbs (-лаа) for narrative momentum.
audioPurpose: Audio read-back of written travel blog post.
successCriteria: Produces written travel post containing at least 3 correctly formed verbs in -лаа4
Includes vivid environmental adjectives: үзэсгэлэнтэй, сүрлэг, тунгалаг
masteryEvidence: Drafts 'Бид өнгөрсөн амралтын өдрөөр Тэрэлж рүү явлаа. Уулын орой дээр гарч, байгалийн сайхныг биширлээ...' flawlessly.

title: Acoustic Lab: Travel Podcast on Off-Road Steppe Expeditions
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of an authentic travel podcast detailing off-road 4WD challenges, river crossings, flat tires, and hospitable nomadic rescues.
communicativeOutcome: Extract travel route details, mechanical mishaps, and cultural interactions from an unscripted travel podcast episode.
listeningObjective: Identify specific travel mishaps ('Машины дугуй хагараад, нутгийн малчин ах ирж тусаллаа') from podcast audio.
spokenProductionObjective: Summarize the podcast's river crossing story to a classmate in 3 sentences.
registerTarget: Dynamic audio broadcast travel storytelling register
pragmaticTarget: Parsing lively narrative speech punctuated with humor and natural sound effects.
reviewReason: Expands transport listening from urban buses to off-road steppe journeys.
audioPurpose: Realistic podcast audio featuring two travel hosts sharing road trip anecdotes with engine ambiance.
successCriteria: Identifies the travel destination and primary challenge encountered from audio
Extracts how the traveling companions resolved their mechanical hurdle
masteryEvidence: Accurately answers 5 comprehension questions following a 2-minute travel podcast excerpt.

title: Back from the Gobi: Exchanging Vacation Highlights with Friends
primaryPurpose: Master spoken communication for sharing vacation adventures: discussing route highlights, bumpy off-road tracks, homestays with nomadic herders, and scenic canyons.
communicativeOutcome: Share vacation highlights with a friend, inquire about their travels, describe natural sights visited, and recommend off-the-beaten-path destinations.
listeningObjective: Understand travel enthusiast enthusiastically describing camel riding across Khongor Sand Dunes.
spokenProductionObjective: Recount vacation highlights: 'Бид Говь гурван сайханд очоод, мөст хавцлаар алхлаа. Замдаа олон зэрлэг ан амьтан харлаа'.
pragmaticTarget: Sharing travel stories with expressive adjectives and authentic enthusiasm.
reviewReason: Expands weekend recreation dialogue into comprehensive multi-provincial expedition debriefs.
audioPurpose: Warm, animated conversational dialogue between two friends back from summer holidays.
successCriteria: Describes itinerary, transport, and notable scenery using past forms accurately
Asks partner engaged follow-up questions about their trip
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn vacation sharing dialogue highlighting 3 destinations and activities.

title: Weekend Rhythms: The Habitual Aspect (-даг/-дэг/-дог/-дөг)
primaryPurpose: Deepen the habitual aspect suffix (-даг4 / -дэг / -дог / -дөг) to describe regular hobbies, recurring weekend traditions, cultural visits, and lifestyle habits.
communicativeOutcome: Explain regular leisure routines: 'Би хагас сайн өдөр бүр ууланд алхдаг' (I hike in the mountains every Saturday), 'Манай гэр бүл амралтын өдрөөр музей үздэг' (Our family visits museums on weekends).
readingObjective: Read a lifestyle survey article detailing how Ulaanbaatar residents spend their leisure hours.
listeningObjective: Identify habitual verbal endings in -даг4 in conversational audio interviews.
writingObjective: Write 4 sentences detailing your recurring weekly hobbies using -даг4.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain weekend habits: 'Би бүтэн сайн өдөр номын санд сууж ном уншдаг'.
registerTarget: Standard everyday leisure and lifestyle register
pragmaticTarget: Using habitual aspect (-даг4) to describe established regular customs rather than single isolated events.
reviewReason: Expands daily morning routines into rich cultural pastimes and recreational traditions.
audioPurpose: Model rhythmic articulation of habitual suffix (-даг/-дэг/-дог/-дөг).
successCriteria: Selects correct harmonic variant of -даг4 based on verb stem vowel
Contrasts recurring habits (-даг) with immediate witnessed events (-лаа)
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би өглөө бүр гүйдэг, харин өчигдөр ууланд алхлаа' with clear aspectual contrast.

title: Opera, Galleries & Concerts: Cultural Outings Vocabulary
primaryPurpose: Introduce cultural entertainment, performance arts, and museum vocabulary (дуурь бүжгийн эрдмийн театр, уран зургийн галерей, цирк, тоглолт үзэх, үзэсгэлэн, тасалбар захиалах).
communicativeOutcome: Talk about attending classical opera, art exhibitions, traditional concerts, and booking performance tickets.
readingObjective: Read a monthly cultural event poster for the National Academic Theatre of Opera and Ballet.
listeningObjective: Understand friends debating whether to attend a folk orchestra concert or an art gallery opening.
writingObjective: List 5 cultural venues in Ulaanbaatar in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe cultural outings: 'Манай гэр бүл сард нэг удаа дуурийн театрт очиж сонгодог балет үздэг'.
registerTarget: Refined cultural arts and recreation register
pragmaticTarget: Expressing artistic appreciation and engaging in metropolitan cultural life.
reviewReason: Elevates cinema/sports vocabulary to fine arts, opera, and cultural exhibitions.
audioPurpose: Pronounce cultural arts venues and genre terms clearly.
successCriteria: Defines дуурь (opera), балет (ballet), үзэсгэлэн (exhibition), галерей (gallery)
Forms sentences using habitual aspect describing cultural outing frequencies
masteryEvidence: Accurately plans and describes 3 distinct cultural outing itineraries in Ulaanbaatar.

title: How Do You Unwind: Exchanging Weekend Habits with Coworkers
primaryPurpose: Develop spoken communicative fluency for Monday morning chats: discussing how you recharge on weekends, recurring sports activities, and favorite quiet spots.
communicativeOutcome: Exchange weekend leisure routines with a colleague, discuss favorite cafes or hiking trails, and compare habitual schedules.
listeningObjective: Understand coworker sharing their Sunday routine of cycling in Bogd Khan mountain foothills.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain regular weekend: 'Би амралтын өдрөөр эрт босоод, найзуудтайгаа сагс тоглодог. Орой нь гэр бүлээрээ амардаг'.
pragmaticTarget: Building social rapport on Monday mornings through pleasant personal exchanges.
reviewReason: Shifts weekend discussions from specific past events to general habitual lifestyles.
audioPurpose: Warm, cheerful Monday morning workplace dialogue between friendly colleagues.
successCriteria: Expresses recurring activities using habitual verb forms in -даг4 accurately
Asks partner engaged questions about their recreational preferences
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn weekend routine sharing dialogue highlighting 3 habitual pastimes.

title: Acoustic Lab: Street Interviews on City Leisure & Fitness Habits
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of spontaneous street interviews with diverse citizens describing their weekly exercise, reading, and cinema habits.
communicativeOutcome: Extract frequency details (өдөр бүр, хааяа, сард нэг, долоо хоногт хоёр удаа) and habitual pastimes from unscripted interview audio.
listeningObjective: Identify specific recreational activities and frequencies across 3 diverse street interviewees.
spokenProductionObjective: Summarize the survey findings to a partner in 3 Mongolian sentences.
pragmaticTarget: Parsing varied colloquial accents and ambient street acoustics.
reviewReason: Applies interview listening skills to leisure and lifestyle surveys.
audioPurpose: Dynamic street interview clips with authentic city background ambience.
successCriteria: Identifies each interviewee's primary hobby correctly from audio
Associates each hobby with its stated frequency adverb (байнга, хааяа, огт үгүй)
masteryEvidence: Accurately completes a lifestyle survey grid based on 3 spoken interviews.

title: Lifestyle Portrait: Composing a Personal Leisure & Hobbies Essay
primaryPurpose: Synthesize habitual aspect verbs (-даг4), leisure vocabulary, and frequency adverbs into a written personal essay (Миний чөлөөт цаг ба сонирхол).
communicativeOutcome: Write a 6-sentence personal essay detailing your leisure habits, how you balance work and relaxation, and hobbies you pursue regularly.
readingObjective: Review a model personal lifestyle profile from a student magazine.
writingObjective: Draft a 6-sentence leisure profile utilizing at least 3 verbs in -даг4 and 2 frequency adverbs.
pragmaticTarget: Expressing well-rounded personal interests with structured, coherent paragraphs.
reviewReason: Combines coordinating clauses with habitual aspect predicates.
audioPurpose: Audio read-back of written personal leisure profile.
successCriteria: Produces written profile using at least 3 correctly formed verbs in -даг4
Demonstrates lexical variety covering physical fitness, reading, or arts
masteryEvidence: Drafts 'Би чөлөөт цагаараа уран зохиолын ном унших дуртай. Мөн долоо хоногт хоёр удаа усан санд сэлдэг...' flawlessly.

title: I'd Love to: The Desiderative Participle (-маар/-мээр/-моор/-мөөр)
primaryPurpose: Introduce the desiderative/inclination participle (-маар4 / -мээр / -моор / -мөөр + байна/санагдах) expressing personal desire, wish, or inclination ('would like to do').
communicativeOutcome: Express polite personal wishes and desires: 'Би халуун кофе уумаар байна' (I would like to drink hot coffee), 'Бид кино үзмээр байна' (We'd like to see a movie).
readingObjective: Read social media posts where friends express desires for weekend trips and outings.
listeningObjective: Identify desiderative verbal endings in -маар4 in audio dialogues.
writingObjective: Write 4 sentences expressing personal wishes for the upcoming weekend using -маар байна.
spokenProductionObjective: Express personal desire: 'Би энэ амралтын өдрөөр хөдөө агаарт гармаар байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Using -маар байна as a gentle, polite expression of desire rather than blunt imperatives.
reviewReason: Expands simple volitional future forms into nuanced desiderative expressions.
audioPurpose: Model harmonious vowel elongation in suffix (-маар, -мээр, -моор, -мөөр).
successCriteria: Attaches correct harmonic variant of -маар4 to verb stems
Combines -маар4 with existential auxiliary байна to form complete predicate
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би өнөө орой найзуудтайгаа уулзмаар байна' with natural phonological flow.

title: Birthdays, Dinners & Gatherings: Social Invitations Vocabulary
primaryPurpose: Introduce social gathering and party vocabulary (урилга, зочлох, төрсөн өдөр тэмдэглэх, цугларах, хамт хооллох, баяр хүргэх, бэлэг өгөх).
communicativeOutcome: Invite friends to birthday parties, dinner gatherings, and home visits; discuss event details and gift ideas.
readingObjective: Read printed and digital party invitation cards specifying date, venue, and dress code.
listeningObjective: Understand an audio voicemail inviting a friend to a celebratory dinner.
writingObjective: List 5 essential elements of a social invitation in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Extend an invitation: 'Би маргааш орой төрсөн өдрөө тэмдэглэнэ, чамайг уримаар байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Offering social invitations with sincere, generous hospitality.
reviewReason: Deepens basic invitation phrases into nuanced social event organization.
audioPurpose: Pronounce festive event vocabulary clearly.
successCriteria: Defines урилга (invitation), цугларах (gather), зочлох (visit/be a guest)
Forms invitations combining -маар байна with volitional proposals (-я/-е)
masteryEvidence: Accurately plans and articulates an invitation to a housewarming or birthday gathering.

title: Join Us Tonight: Extending & Accepting Warm Social Invitations
primaryPurpose: Master spoken communication for extending, accepting, and coordinating social invitations: agreeing on meeting spots, asking what to bring, and confirming times.
communicativeOutcome: Invite a friend or colleague to a social event, accept an invitation enthusiastically ('Дуртайяа очьё!'), and coordinate logistics.
listeningObjective: Understand friend proposing a group dinner: 'Бид өнөө орой шинэ монгол хоолны газар ормоор байна, чи хамт явах уу?'.
spokenProductionObjective: Accept and ask details: 'Маш сайхан санаа байна, би дуртайяа очьё! Хэдэн цагт, хаана уулзах вэ?'.
pragmaticTarget: Expressing enthusiasm and asking politely whether to bring a dish or drink.
reviewReason: Expands invitation dialogues with flexible desiderative constructions.
audioPurpose: Warm, engaging phone dialogue between friends coordinating a weekend dinner outing.
successCriteria: Extends invitation using -маар байна and accepts using volitional -я
Confirms time and meeting location clearly
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn invitation dialogue agreeing on dinner arrangements smoothly.

title: RSVP Follow-Up Call: Confirming Attendance, Directions & Potluck Dishes
primaryPurpose: Execute a telephone conversation to RSVP for a dinner gathering, ask what to bring, and confirm directions.
communicativeOutcome: Extract event type (housewarming, graduation celebration), time, location, and RSVP instructions from spoken voice messages.
listeningObjective: Identify specific party details across 3 distinct audio voicemails.
spokenProductionObjective: Confirm attendance: 'Баярлалаа, би заавал очно оо. Би юу авчрах хэрэгтэй вэ?'.
pragmaticTarget: Extracting key event data from fast, casual voice notes with background chatter.
reviewReason: Applies recorded messaging listening skills to social invitations.
audioPurpose: Realistic voice note acoustics with varying microphone closeness and casual friendly inflection.
successCriteria: Identifies occasion, date, and address correctly from audio clips
Detects whether the host requests bringing specific items

title: Lease & Furnishings: Apartment Rental Contracts & Household Amenities
primaryPurpose: Introduce real estate leasing, apartment inventory, and appliance vocabulary (түрээсийн гэрээ, барьцаа мөнгө, сарын төлбөр, тавилгатай, хөргөгч, угаалгын машин, ашиглалтын зардал).
communicativeOutcome: Inspect apartment listings, understand rental lease terms (contract length, security deposit, monthly rent, utility bills), and check included furniture and appliances.
readingObjective: Read an authentic online real estate classified advertisement detailing 2-room apartment amenities.
listeningObjective: Understand landlord listing inventory items during apartment walk-through.
writingObjective: List 5 essential household appliances in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Inquire about lease terms: 'Энэ байр бүрэн тавилгатай юу, бас сарын төлбөрт ашиглалтын зардал орсон уу?'.
registerTarget: Standard real estate commercial transaction register
pragmaticTarget: Clarifying whether utility costs (цахилгаан, дулаан, ус, СӨХ) are included in rent.
reviewReason: Expands basic housing vocabulary into formal contractual leasing and furnishings.
audioPurpose: Pronounce real estate legal and domestic appliance terminology clearly.
successCriteria: Defines түрээсийн гэрээ (lease agreement), барьцаа (security deposit), ашиглалтын зардал (utility costs)
Identifies furniture adjectives: тавилгатай (furnished), тавилгагүй (unfurnished)
masteryEvidence: Accurately calculates total initial move-in cost based on rent and deposit figures.

title: Deciphering the Lease: Rights, Deposits & Maintenance Clauses
primaryPurpose: Develop targeted reading comprehension of an authentic Mongolian residential lease agreement (Орон сууц хөлслөх гэрээ), termination clauses, and damage deposits.
communicativeOutcome: Inspect a standard rental contract, locate payment deadlines (сар бүрийн 25-ны дотор), deposit return conditions, and early termination notice requirements.
readingObjective: Locate monthly rent due date, deposit forfeiture conditions, and 30-day notice clause in a 150-word contract snippet.
writingObjective: Transcribe key contract clauses into a tenant rights checklist.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain to a prospective flatmate when the deposit is refundable under the contract.
registerTarget: Formal legal and commercial contract register
pragmaticTarget: Scrutinizing lease terms for potential hidden liabilities or strict penalties.
reviewReason: Extends commercial contract reading to real estate lease agreements.
audioPurpose: Read contractual leasing clauses aloud.
successCriteria: Identifies contract duration (1 жил) and monthly payment deadline accurately
Extracts conditions under which the security deposit (барьцаа) is returned
masteryEvidence: Answers 4 comprehension questions based on an authentic Mongolian rental contract excerpt.

title: Deciphering Rental Lease Covenants, Security Deposits & Utility Clauses
primaryPurpose: Read standard legal clauses in Mongolian residential leases detailing deposit return, utility billing, and maintenance.
communicativeOutcome: Follow a landlord explaining how the water heater functions, noting existing scratches on the floor, and recording meter readings.
readingObjective: Identify required deposit sums, monthly due dates, and tenant damage liabilities in contract text.
listeningObjective: Identify specific appliance operational instructions and preexisting defects noted by the landlord.
spokenProductionObjective: Point out an unrecorded flaw: 'Энэ угаалгын машины хаалга жаахан гажсан байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Ensuring all preexisting flaws are acknowledged by both parties before signing.
reviewReason: Applies civic housing listening to practical apartment walk-throughs.
audioPurpose: Realistic apartment walk-through audio with footstep echoes, running faucet, and cabinet door clicks.
successCriteria: Extracts current electricity meter reading correctly from audio
Identifies which appliance the landlord promises to repair before move-in
masteryEvidence: Accurately completes a move-in inspection checklist based on walk-through audio.

title: Meeting the Landlord: Negotiating Rent, Deposit & Move-In Date
primaryPurpose: Master spoken communication for negotiating residential leases: requesting a slight rent reduction for long-term lease, splitting the deposit, and setting move-in date.
communicativeOutcome: Negotiate rental terms with a landlord: agree on rent payment schedule (3 months in advance vs monthly), deposit terms, and key handover date.
listeningObjective: Understand landlord offering a slight discount if 6 months of rent is paid upfront.
spokenProductionObjective: Negotiate terms: 'Хэрэв би нэг жилээр гэрээ хийвэл сарын төлбөрийг бага зэрэг буулгаж өгөх боломж байна уу?'.
pragmaticTarget: Negotiating residential lease terms respectfully without undermining trust.
reviewReason: Applies commercial bargaining and polite persuasion to residential leases.
audioPurpose: Polite, balanced dialogue between respectful prospective tenant and reasonable property owner.
successCriteria: Proposes and confirms monthly rent and payment frequency (3 сар, 6 сар)
Confirms move-in date and key handover protocol
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn lease negotiation roleplay reaching agreement on rent and deposit.
